items.source: Based on the standard EventListener interface for the Observer design pattern.
items.translation: 基于标准 EventListener 接口的观察者设计模式。

items.source: An ApplicationListener can generically declare the event type that it is interested in. When registered with a Spring ApplicationContext, events will be filtered accordingly, with the listener getting invoked for matching event objects only.
items.translation: `ApplicationListener` 可以泛型声明其感兴趣的事件类型。当将其注册到 Spring `ApplicationContext` 时，事件将据此进行过滤，只有匹配的事件对象才会触发监听器的调用。

items.source: Create a new ApplicationListener for the given payload consumer.
items.translation: 为给定的负载创建者创建一个新ApplicationListener。

items.source: Return whether this listener supports asynchronous execution.
items.translation: 返回该监听器是否支持异步执行。

items.source: E - the specific ApplicationEvent subclass to listen to
items.translation: E - 要监听的具体 ApplicationEvent 子类

items.source: true if this listener instance can be executed asynchronously depending on the multicaster configuration (the default), or false if it needs to immediately run within the original thread which published the event
items.translation: 如果此监听器实例可以根据多播器配置异步执行（默认情况），则为true；否则，如果它需要在发布事件的原始线程中立即运行，则为false。

items.source: T - the type of the event payload
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
